svg.title: The loss surface and the path gradient descent takes
svg.desc: Contour map of mean squared error over slope m and intercept b, darkest where the error is lowest. The descent path starts at m = 0, b = 0, jumps almost straight to the right slope within a few steps, then creeps along a long shallow valley in the b direction until it reaches the minimum near m = 2.28, b = 4.32.
svg.text: The loss surface and the path gradient descent takes
steep in m: close within 2 steps
shallow in b: a slow climb
